from datetime import datetime, timedelta

    date: str
    start_time: str
    mark_email: EmailStr
    location: str

emails = search_emails("hiking trip", None)
if len(emails) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No emails found about the hiking trip.")

info = query_ai_assistant(
    "Extract the date, start time, Mark's email address, and the location for the hiking trip from these emails. If there are multiple emails, use the most recent and relevant information.",
    HikingTripInfo,
)

start_dt = datetime.strptime(info.date + " " + info.start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
end_dt = start_dt + timedelta(hours=5)

create_calendar_event(
    title="Hiking Trip with Mark",
    start_time=start_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
    end_time=end_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
    description="Hiking trip with Mark. Details from email.",
    participants=[info.mark_email],
    location=info.location,
)
